Painterly slightly photoreal tactile storybook game art, dimensional soft lighting matching reference world. Single canonical full-body neutral standing hunch, three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, both empty hands visible, grounded feet at same baseline. Transparent background; generous clear margins around ALL wisps, hands and feet. No scene, floor, cast shadow, labels, text, borders or sprite-sheet layout.
